title: French Uruguayan Empanada Crisps
description: A crispy twist on traditional French empanadas, infused with the flavors of Uruguay.
instructions: Cut the empanada dough into 12 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of the onion and bacon mixture in the center of each circle.
Top with a sprinkle of the score cheese blend.
Brush the edges with olive oil and fold the dough in half to form a half-circle.
Press the edges to seal and use a fork to crimp.
Cut the empanada into strips and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the crushed empanada dough on top of the strips.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
